decision: Run one exact local-attention component and paired minimum counter capture. Run one c32 control/candidate pair only if correctness and both physical stages pass and the conservative whole-request bound is at least 3%, or the measured retained stack reaches 0.6381105231 seconds/request.
hypothesis: A block-local QK/softmax producer writes each score-derived probability once, then a separate two-slice V consumer ends the QK live range before the value accumulator. Neither stage should exceed 128 registers/thread or one register-limited CTA/SM, and 289 MiB of bounded representative workspace traffic should cost less than the fused kernel's measured register serialization and spills without duplicating QK math.

library_coverage.reason: Current FlashAttention and FlashInfer expose fused attention outputs for supported paged/sliding inputs; neither exposes the required persisted block-local probability/statistics producer followed by the separately profiled sliced-V consumer while preserving this pinned page-1 FP8 E5M2 contract.

arm_policy: One candidate only. The process contains a discovery call, alternating exact-family timing, and one three-kernel NCU capture. Do not replay value-split2, alter tiles, change KV heads or precision, or run the endpoint unless the frozen gate passes.
